verses.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਪਹੁਚੇ ਠਿਕਾਨੇ ਆਲਸ ਬਿਲੰਬ ਕੀਏ ਖੋਜ ਮਿਟ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: khojee khoj dhekh chalio jai pahuche Thikaane aalas bila(n)b ke'ee khoj miT jaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a tracker proceeds along the footprints and reaches the desired place, but had he been lazy or complacent, these footprints trail would have been obliterated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸਮੈ ਰਮੈ ਭਰਤਾਰ ਬਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਜਉ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sihajaa samai ramai bharataar bar naar soiee karai jau agiaan maan pragaTat praat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a woman who moving to the bed of her husband at night is fortunate to enjoy the union with her husband is the prime wife of that man. But one who shows arrogance due to ignorance loses the opportunity of this union because of her laziness and complacency.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਰਖਤ ਮੇਘ ਜਲ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਪੀਏ ਮੋਨ ਗਹੇ ਬਰਖਾ ਬਤੀਤੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: barakhat megh jal chaatirak tirapat pe'ee mon gahe barakhaa bateete bilalaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a rain-bird may be able to quench his thirst when it is raining, but if he does not open his mouth and the rain stops, then he wails and cry.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਰਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਕੀਏ ਪਾਛੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੪੦॥
verses.translit_en: sikh soiee sun gur sabadh rahat rahai kapaT saneh ke'ee paachhe pachhutaat hai ||440||

en.bdb: Similarly, he alone is an obedient Sikh of the True Guru, who listens to His sermon and adopts it in his life immediately. Otherwise, one would lose the opportune moment and repent thereafter. (440)
